newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Midas to issue fewer shares to parent.
newsitem.headline: Midas to issue fewer shares to parent.

text.p: Midas Printing Group Ltd said its controlling shareholder, ERI Holdings Ltd, after placing existing Midas shares, had reduced the number of new shares it will subscribe for to 17.87 million shares from 18.50 million.
The company gave no details on the reduction.
Midas said ERI's stake in the company will be diluted to 40.07 percent from 43.63 percent on completion of the placing and subscription.

Earlier this month, Midas said ERI had agreed to place 18.50 million existing shares at HK$0.91 each to independent investors before subscribing for the same amount of new shares at a price equivalent to the net placing price after expenses.
ERI's stake in Midas was to have been diluted to 40.23 percent after that deal.
Midas shares fell HK$0.04 to end at HK$0.96 each on Thursday.
